name: design
description: A senior/staff design team — seven desks (design lead, critic, reviewer, accessibility auditor, design-system steward, content designer, metrics analyst), twelve process skills (framing, research, critique, review, handoff, decision records, WCAG 2.2, DTCG tokens, content design, metrics), and the neuro-design evidence base (six lenses, an audit skill and a reviewer agent).
